download_method: Official ZIP central directory and bounded HTTP ranges; initial data parts from ETH; remaining selected member bytes from public byte-identical Hugging Face mirror. Each whole selected member checked against official CRC32; extracted files also checked by zipfile CRC.

mh01_bag.original_local_source: previously downloaded local MH01 cache; verified against official archive

mh02_bag: Converted from verified ASL images/CSV with exact integer timestamp_ns. Contains only /cam0/image_raw, /cam1/image_raw, /imu0. No ground truth input.
used_camera_model: Official VINS-Fusion EuRoC stereo-IMU config uses repository cam0_mei.yaml and cam1_mei.yaml unchanged; archive pinhole calibration and camera-IMU extrinsics preserved separately.
ground_truth: Extracted official state_groundtruth_estimate0/data.csv; evaluation only after the run.
